review_candidates.title: CFA 2026 003 | Senior Project Associate (Response) | Roster only
review_candidates.description: Job Description Introduction Established in 1951, IOM is a Related Organization of the United Nations and the leading UN agency in the field of migration. Working closely with governmental, intergovernmental and non-governmental partners, IOM promotes humane and orderly migration for the benefit of all. It saves lives and protects people on the move, drives solutions to displacement, and facilitates pathways for regular migration, while providing services and advice to governments and migrants. IOM is committed to fostering a respectful, inclusive and supportive workplace where all employees can thrive professionally and feel valued. By creating such an environment, IOM aims to better harness the full potential of migration and strengthen its support to people on the move. IOM invites candidates from diverse backgrounds to apply and provides reasonable accommodation throughout the recruitment process when required. Learn more about IOM’s workplace culture at IOM workplace culture | International Organization for Migration Applications are welcome from internal and external candidates. For all IOM vacancies, applications from qualified and eligible first-tier candidates are considered before those of qualified and eligible second-tier candidates in the selection process. For the purpose of this vacancy, internal and internal-equivalent candidates are considered as first-tier candidates. Organizational Context and Scope This Call for Applications aims to establish a roster of qualified candidates who may be mobilized to support the Mission’s surge staffing requirements during disasters, emergencies, and other humanitarian response operations. Please note that there is currently no confirmed start date or immediate deployment opportunity associated with this roster. The engagement of roster members will depend on operational requirements, the nature and scale of emergency responses, funding and budget availability, and the Mission’s staffing needs. Candidates who submit an application acknowledge their interest in being considered for future emergency response assignments and are expected to maintain their availability should their services be required. If selected for deployment or engagement, roster members must be locally available and be prepared to promptly complete all necessary onboarding, documentation, and administrative requirements within the prescribed timeframe. As part of your application, kindly submit a cover letter indicating any relevant experience in emergency response and/or the following areas: Shelter, Water, Sanitation and Hygiene (WASH), Cash-Based Interventions (CBI), Mental Health and Psychosocial Support (MHPSS), Community Mobilization, and Information Management and Reporting. Your cover letter should briefly describe your experience, key responsibilities, and any relevant skills or training related to these areas. Responsibilities Assist in the planning, coordination, implementation, and monitoring of emergency response activities, ensuring timely and effective delivery of humanitarian assistance in line with project objectives, humanitarian principles, and donor requirements. Compile, analyse, and present information and data on disaster impacts, humanitarian needs, response operations, and operational developments to support evidence-based decision-making and response planning. Monitor project budget implementation and resource utilization, identifying funding gaps and proposing adjustments to support efficient and accountable emergency response operations. Serve as the focal point for administrative and operational coordination of emergency response activities, liaising with internal units and external stakeholders to facilitate procurement, logistics, deployments, clearances, and other operational requirements. Prepare situation reports, implementation updates, and progress reports, identify operational challenges and delivery gaps, escalate critical issues to the supervisor, and recommend corrective actions to improve response effectiveness. Draft correspondence, briefing notes, donor reports, presentations, maps, dashboards, statistical tables, and other operational documentation to support coordination, reporting, and decision-making during emergency response operations. Organize and support coordination meetings, simulations, trainings, and capacity-building activities for government counterparts, humanitarian partners, and response personnel on emergency preparedness, response, and recovery. Respond to complex operational information requests, maintain project records, and ensure accurate documentation of emergency response activities, beneficiary data, and operational outputs. Participate in inter-agency coordination mechanisms and technical working groups, maintaining effective collaboration with government agencies, local authorities, UN agencies, humanitarian clusters, NGOs, donors, and other stakeholders to strengthen coordinated emergency response efforts. Monitor the implementation of activities by implementing partners, ensuring compliance with project agreements, humanitarian standards, IOM policies, and donor requirements, and promptly report any issues to the supervisor. Contribute to the development and revision of Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), contingency plans, emergency response guidelines, after-action reviews, lessons learned, and concept notes to strengthen preparedness and future emergency response programming. Provides guidance/training and assist in coordinating and monitoring work of other staff in the unit. May supervise other staff as assigned. Perform such other relevant duties as maybe assigned. Qualifications Required Qualifications and Experience Education Bachelor’s degree in Political Science, Social Science, International Relations, Development Studies, Migration Studies, Human Rights, Law or a related field from an accredited academic institution with four years of relevant professional experience; or, High School diploma with six years of relevant professional experience. Accredited Universities are those listed in the UNESCO World Higher Education Database. Experience Experience in liaising with governmental authorities, national/international institutions, United Nations agencies and non-governmental organisations; Experience in working with migrants, refugees, internally displaced persons, victims of trafficking and other vulnerable groups; and, Prior work experience with international humanitarian organisations, non-government or government institutions/organisation in a multi-cultural setting is an advantage. Skills Knowledge of emergency preparedness, disaster response, and humanitarian operations in the Philippines. Strong understanding of Disaster Risk Reduction (DRR), Climate Change Adaptation (CCA), and humanitarian principles and standards. Excellent analytical, organizational, and problem-solving skills. Strong written and verbal communication skills, including technical and donor reporting. Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite, particularly Excel, Word, PowerPoint, and Teams. Languages All IOM staff members in all categories are required to be fluent in one of the IOM's official languages (English, French, Spanish). For this position, Tagalog is required. Proficiency of language(s) required will be specifically evaluated during the selection process, which may include written and/or oral assessments. Required Competencies IOM’s competency framework can be found at this link . Competencies will be assessed during the selection process. Values - all IOM staff members must abide by and demonstrate these five values: Inclusion and respect for diversity: Respects and promotes individual and cultural differences. Encourages diversity and inclusion. Integrity and transparency: Maintains high ethical standards and acts in a manner consistent with organizational principles/rules and standards of conduct. Professionalism: Demonstrates ability to work in a composed, competent and committed manner and exercises careful judgment in meeting day-to-day challenges. Courage: Demonstrates willingness to take a stand on issues of importance. Empathy: Shows compassion for others, makes people feel safe, respected and fairly treated. Core Competencies – behavioural indicators Level 2 Teamwork: Develops and promotes effective collaboration within and across units to achieve shared goals and optimize results. Delivering results: Produces and delivers quality results in a service-oriented and timely manner. Is action oriented and committed to achieving agreed outcomes. Managing and sharing knowledge: Continuously seeks to learn, share knowledge and innovate. Accountability: Takes ownership for achieving the Organization’s priorities and assumes responsibility for own actions and delegated work. Communication: Encourages and contributes to clear and open communication. Explains complex matters in an informative, inspiring and motivational way. Managerial Competencies – behavioural indicators Level 2, if with direct reports Leadership: Provides a clear sense of direction, leads by example and demonstrates the ability to carry out the Organization’s vision. Assists others to realize and develop their leadership and professional potential. Empowering others: Creates an enabling environment where staff can contribute their best and develop their potential. Building Trust: Promotes shared values and creates an atmosphere of trust and honesty. Strategic thinking and vision: Works strategically to realize the Organization’s goals and communicates a clear strategic direction. Humility: Leads with humility and shows openness to acknowledging own shortcomings. Notes Please refer to this link for guidance on IOM Job Category. Any offer made to the candidate in relation to this vacancy notice is subject to funding confirmation. This selection process may be used to staff similar positions in various duty stations. Recommended candidates will remain eligible to be appointed in a similar position for a period of 24 months. Appointment will be subject to certification that the candidate is medically fit for appointment, accreditation, any residency or visa requirements, security clearances. IOM has a zero-tolerance policy on conduct that is incompatible with the aims and objectives of the United Nations and IOM, including sexual exploitation and abuse, sexual harassment, abuse of authority and discrimination based on gender, nationality, age, race, sexual orientation, religious or ethnic background or disabilities. IOM does not charge a fee at any stage of its recruitment process (application, interview, processing, training or other fee). IOM does not request any information related to bank accounts. IOM only accepts duly completed applications submitted through the IOM e-Recruitment system (for internal candidates link here ). The online tool also allows candidates to track the status of their application. No late applications will be accepted. Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted. For further information and other job postings, you are welcome to visit our website: IOM Careers and Job Vacancies

review_candidates.title: Business Development Manager (Renewable/Solar Energy)
review_candidates.description: Company Description Copper Mountain Energy (“CME”) is a company specializing in investing and developing renewable energy in Vietnam. We aim to become a leading and prestigious company in renewable energy sector and contribute towards a low carbon economy. For more information about CME, please join our website: http://cmenergy.vn/ CME is led by a seasoned management team with leading partners in the energy sector with many years of experience in deploying and operating power plants in Vietnam. We are looking for: BUSINESS DEVELOPMENT DIRECTOR/MANAGER (OPEN FOR EXPAT) Job Summary The Business Development Director/Manager is responsible for driving business growth through strategic opportunity development and end-to-end sales execution. This role focuses on building a strong pipeline, closing high-value deals, and developing long-term client partnerships. Main Responsibilities: 1. Business Development & Strategy Develop and expand a strong pipeline of industrial clients (factories, FDI, industrial zones) by identifying, targeting, and converting high-potential accounts. Develop and execute growth strategies, build and manage a high-quality pipeline of rooftop solar projects to achieve revenue targets. Analyze market trends, competitors, and customer insights to refine go-to-market approach and advise strategic direction. 2. Client Acquisition & Relationship Management Develop and maintain client relationships while expanding key accounts and networks to drive business growth, and long-term partnerships. Manage the entire client lifecycle to ensure seamless communication and high client satisfaction throughout the project journey. 3. Deal Structuring & Negotiation Lead end-to-end deal execution from proposal development to contract closure, including pricing, commercial terms in line with the laws, the Company’s regulations Collaborate with Legal, Finance, and Technical teams to finalize bankable agreements (PPA, EPC) 4. Reporting Deliver periodic reports (monthly, quarterly, yearly) on sales performance, pipeline status, and revenue forecasts. What we're looking for: Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Economics, Engineering, or related fields. At least 5 years of experience in B2B sales/business development, preferably in industrial sales, renewable energy, or infrastructure. Strong networks within industrial zones and experience working with manufacturing or FDI companies is an advantage. Good understanding in Vietnam Renewable Energy market and fundamental process of getting permits to develop Renewable project is highly advantage. Strong business acumen, strategic thinking and results-oriented leadership. Excellent negotiation, deal-closing, and client acquisition skills. Ability to manage multiple projects and work in a fast-paced environment. Good communication and presentation skills. Good English/ Japanese/ Korean/ Chinese communication is a plus. Willing to travel as requested. Why join us: Competitive salary package with attractive sales incentive scheme per deal. Business entertainment budget and company-provided cars for business travel. ·Performance-based bonuses aligned with business results. Opportunity to work with leading clients in a high-growth renewable energy sector. Clear career progression and exposure to large-scale, high-value projects.
